name: BACH_0349_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 5 of 5 similar cases support this [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Near-certain invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.0 / 96th percentile | No flag raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 4) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scored far below typical; less benign tissue · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · High score, but failed spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 3, 4, 11) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Degraded simulated frozen section (resample, severity 3); reliability score ranks errors only moderately (AUROC 0.69).
- Mitosis, necrosis and normal-lobule cues failed AI spot checks; only stroma and pleomorphism are validated support.

## Check on the slide
1. **0, 4** Confirm marked pleomorphism and tumor-infiltrating stroma, where both concepts peak.
2. **0, 1, 4** Count mitoses directly; the mitoses concept failed its spot check.
3. **0–3, 8–11** Check superior and inferior margins for tumor [F7].
